summary: This is a VS Code debug configuration file that sets up remote debugging for a Python FastAPI application. It tells the debugger to connect to a Python process already running on localhost at port 5679, and maps your local source files to the remote paths so breakpoints work correctly.

explanations.6: The name is just a label that appears in VS Code's debug dropdown so you can identify this configuration.
explanations.7: "attach" means the debugger will connect to an already-running Python process, rather than launching a new one.
explanations.8: This object specifies where to find the Python process you want to debug — in this case, on your local machine at port 5679.
explanations.12: Setting this to true means the debugger will only step through your own code, not through third-party libraries, keeping debugging less cluttered.
explanations.13: This mapping tells the debugger how to translate file paths so it can find your source code; your local 'src' folder corresponds to the '.' (current directory) on the remote side.
